events.title: 첼시 sign Dutch defender 켄 몽카우 from 페예노르트 for £100,000.
Portugal wins its first FIFA World Youth Championship
레인저스 sign defender Mel Sterland from 셰필드 웬즈데이 on a free.
퀸스 파크 레인저스 set a club record transfer by paying 사우샘프턴 £800,000 for striker Colin Clarke .
맨체스터 시티, pushing for promotion from the Second Division, pay £600,000 for 루턴 타운 midfielder David Oldfield .
사우샘프턴 sign 18-year-old defender Jason Dodd from Conference side Bath City for £50,000.
브렌트퍼드's FA Cup dream ends in the quarter-finals when they lose 4–0 to 리버풀 at Anfield . 노팅엄 포리스트 defeat 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 at Old Trafford . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 노리치 시티 draw 0–0 at Upton Park .
윔블던's defence of the FA Cup ends in a 1–0 defeat to 에버턴 at Goodison Park .
Fourth Division strugglers 스톡포트 카운티 sack player-manager Asa Hartford and replace him with 로치데일 manager Danny Bergera.

노리치 시티 move closer to their first FA Cup final by defeating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 3–1 in the quarter-final replay at Carrow Road . while 사우샘프턴 pay a club record £700,000 for 포츠머스 midfielder Barry Horne . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 also break their transfer fee record by paying £1.1million to bring striker Frank McAvennie back to the club after 18 months at 셀틱 .
고든 스트라컨 leaves 맨체스터 유나이티드 after nearly five years to join 리즈 유나이티드 for £300,000. Trevor Francis bolsters the 퀸스 파크 레인저스 midfield with a £350,000 move for 브렌트퍼드's Andy Sinton .

Referee Kelvin Morton awards five penalties in just 27 minutes during the 크리스털 팰리스 versus Brighton & Hove Albion match. 크리스털 팰리스 miss three of their four penalties, while Brighton score from their only penalty. Palace eventually win the match 2–1.

아스널 remain top of the league, three points ahead of 노리치 시티, while 리버풀, who won six League games this month, have moved into third place with a game in hand and a five-point deficit behind the leaders. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 occupy bottom place with 22 points from 27 games, but 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are now just one point adrift of safety. 사우샘프턴 have slipped into the bottom three. 첼시 have returned to the top of the Second Division, exchanging places with 맨체스터 시티, while the play-off zone is occupied by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 블랙번 로버스, 입스위치 타운 and 본머스.
